Figure with figcaption preserves both image and caption

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<figure><img src="sunset.jpg" alt="A sunset"><figcaption>Beautiful sunset over the ocean</figcaption></figure>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
